scientific_review.method: Compare final claims with selected literal original excerpts and complete rendered pages. Separate core scientific support, format, full answer completion and stability.

checks: Closed form describes the corresponding optimal policy, not a one-step neural-weight fit.
LM sampling exemption retains fine-tuning; data preparation still samples reference-policy completions.
No global sampling-free inference or data-pipeline claim is made.
No seed integer is invented or replaced by an optimizer value or step count.
Absence is limited to supplied evidence, not the entire paper or corpus.
Published policy-object, classification-objective and fine-tuning LM-sampling details follow original passages.
Shared KL constraint lacks support in selected InstructGPT Step 1-3 paragraphs; historical plausibility is not selected-source proof.
The guard first rejects unexpanded SFT in the comparison. The editor verdict cannot override final source restrictions.
Separate details are not presented as a completed cross-paper answer.
4-bit storage is separate from usual BFloat16 computation.
NF4 retains normally distributed weights; double quantization targets quantization constants.
Paged optimizer states move between GPU memory and CPU RAM.
Duplicate reason keys intentionally invalidate the editor JSON, even when repeated values match.
core_source_checks.wording_reservation: No-degradation wording is a cited experimental report, not a universal guarantee. Full prose quality is not released.

scientific_review.earlier_pass_scope: Core original pages checked; historical source fingerprints differ and do not establish final-source stability.
not_asserted: New whole-corpus parsing or generation accuracy
Independent expert review of every sentence
Automatic global resolution of Future Work
Final project or public deployment acceptance

local_failure_replay.scope: Saved outputs under current local rules only

checks.error: 比较子句不能从冻结／低秩说明推断未报告的原始精度。

runtime_recovery.scope: Read-only follow-up snapshot after manually starting the absent Docker Desktop
interpretation: Client timeout does not establish rollback: all 513 previously embedded points persist.
The old run lacks operation-level telemetry; exact historical timeout cause remains unproven.
Memory values are a snapshot, not peak consumption or a measured optimization result.
